note: I RAN make rebaseline IN THE MAIN CHECKOUT WHILE ANOTHER SESSION HAD UNCOMMITTED WORK IN IT, and I want that on the record rather than discovered. Honouring the post-merge hooks advisory after landing the-plumb, I ran rebaseline on main and only afterwards noticed cli/tests/suite/session_cost.rs and clients/game/bin/examples/move_cost.rs carried uncommitted edits stamped 20:41:10, 47 minutes before my 21:27:59 run -- The Rack, Task 5, by their own doc text. No harm done: the artifact tree came back clean, I touched neither file, and the only thing I added is one honest rebaseline row in docs/timings.md. But a 280-second regeneration racing a live editor is a real hazard and it was luck, not care, that it was benign. THE GENERAL POINT: CLAUDE.md tells you not to absorb while mains checkout shows another session mid-landing, and nothing warns you -- make preflight used to peek and is retired. git status in the main checkout BEFORE running anything that writes there costs two seconds. I did it after.
